scope: Exact source-defined prefixed KMBUS_EEPROM_READ 0x43 on local WB2A / VDensHO1 / 20C2.
conclusions: The local 20C2 controller accepts an exact Vitosoft-shaped KMBUS_EEPROM_READ request when PrefixRead=030000000101 is supplied.
The response is a normal successful VS2 response and echoes function code 0x43, address 0x0001 and block length 1.
This hardware-verifies that PrefixRead is operational request data for this 0x43 path, not descriptive metadata.
The returned byte 0x88 must remain raw. The source label 'Kennung (Prog1)' belongs to GWG_BT2/LGM27 metadata and is not yet proven to describe the local WB2A subordinate device.
The result strongly justifies testing the remaining exact source-defined 0x43 block shapes that use the same six-byte prefix. It does not justify a blind EEPROM address sweep.
This path is evidence for access to a subordinate persistent-memory namespace. It is not evidence for main-regulation program-flash access.
next_step: Read the remaining bounded GWG_BT2 source-defined blocks using the same prefix and exact source lengths.
Cross-correlate any stable identity/configuration bytes with local GFA P80/P81/P82/P83 and known burner/coding data without importing GWG_BT2 semantics prematurely.
